files.usenet_style_guide.txt:
USENET POSTING STYLE GUIDE

- Use plain text format with line wrapping at 72 characters
- Include proper headers (From:, Newsgroups:, Subject:)
- Use ASCII art sparingly
- Quote previous messages with > characters
- Sign posts with signature files (max 4 lines)
- Common abbreviations: BTW, IMHO, RTFM, FAQ
- Thread continuation indicated by Re: prefix
files.tech_dialogue_examples.txt:
SAMPLE TECH DISCUSSIONS

1990s Style:
- More formal language
- Detailed technical explanations
- References to specific hardware/software
- Academic tone in many posts

2000s Style:
- Emergence of internet slang
- Shorter attention spans
- More casual discourse
- Pop culture references
